title: The Rotten Kitchen
intro: Flies drift over a feast that rotted a century ago. Something is still simmering. The way up is sealed in the meat locker at the back of the kitchen.

objects.label: Cracked Oven
objects.reward_text: The oven door swings open and something inside SCREAMS.

objects.label: Hungry Ghoul
objects.reward_text: The spirit is amused. It whispers: 'Everything in this room is connected. Finish what you started.'

a_cauldron: To decode, move every letter BACKWARD by the same number of places.
Move each letter back 11. The first letter M becomes ...
The first letter of the answer is B and the word has 10 letters.
The word is BROOMSTICK. The vault's character number 1 is D.
b_cleaver: Percentage changes are applied one after the other, each to the latest price.
The final price is 840 coins. The vault's character number 2 is 5.
c_rack: Open your clue notes: you need the number from the Bubbling Cauldron and the number from the Rusted Cleaver.
Multiply the two numbers, then add each of them once.
36 + 9 + 4 = 49. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are K and P.
dare_ghoul: A dare is optional and never needed to leave the floor.
It never costs you anything to skip it.
Do the dare only if you and your team are happy with it.
It never owns part of the vault code. Skip it freely.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Bubbling Cauldron, Rusted Cleaver, Spice Rack.
